tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya zil gnon zhi bar sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so//

'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// de yang ji skad du| zhi bar bsnyen zhing drag po sgrub// ces gsungs pas/ zla gsang gzhi bsnyen sogs kyi snga rol du/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bsnyen par bya dgos te/ de yang dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ sngon 'gro ni/ zla gsang rgyud kyi le'u bcu par/ dur khrod lung dang mthun pa'i gnas// dgon pa lta bur song nas ni// thog mar bsod nams tshogs kyang bsags| |spyi bshags 'bum la sogs pa 'don// tsha tsha nye'u 'don sogs bya// zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar gsung rab 'don pa sātstsha 'debs pa sogs sgrib sbyong gang 'grub la 'bad dgos so/ */dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su 'jam dbyangs kyi rten bkram pa'i mdun du dkar gtor zar sgong lta bu la padma'i 'dab mas yongs su bskor ba/ rgyan rnam pa du mas mdzes par byas pa'i mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod bshams/ zla gsang man ngag gi rgyud le'u so bdun par/ maṇḍal me tog bcas bkram te| |a ga ru dang du ru ka /bzang po'i bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs// mar dkar mar me rgyun mi gcod// a mṛ tas sbags pa'i nang mchod kyang bshams/ rdor dril la sogs nye bar mkho ba 'du bya/ yo byad thams cad kha na ma tho ba'i skyon rnam par ma dag pa med pa gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar bya'o// de nas khrus byas gos gsar pa gyon gtsang sbra dang ldan pas ku sha la sogs pa'i stan bde bar 'khod de/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bgegs rnams la cha gsum gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar phul la bka' bsgo/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad ngo bo stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang bar gyur par dmigs/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā wa/ badzra satwa hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho hoḥswā hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod gong ltar bsangs sbyangs| mgon po ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gas mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rdo rje'i ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ mda'i dra ba/ phyi rol du rdo rje ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab pa'i bsrung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ badzra tsakra warti bhrūṃ/ badzra rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i rnam pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ a ti pū ho/ pra ti dzaḥhoḥ oṃ ārya mañdzu shrī na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ sogs dang*/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// sogs dang*/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/

byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar sogs gsum dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum bya/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge las dri ma med pa'i 'od zer khams gsum du 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i bag chags sbyangs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yi ge gsum la thim pas rang gi lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba yi ge gsum la thim/ de yang stod nas rim gyis bsdus hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu| khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ slar nā da yang mi dmigs pa chos dang chos nyid gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i dngos po thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ mañdzu badzra shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥmañdzu badzra shuddho3haṃ/ slar rang gi sems nā da'i rnam pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar paṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i sna tshogs padma kha dog dwangs shing 'od zer 'phro ba'i ze'u 'brur a las zla ba nya gang ba'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ dkar po phrag gnyis g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba'i steng du/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la dmar po phrag gnyis g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba/

de dag gi bar du rang gi sems nā da zhugs pa las nā da de nyid so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo muṃ dmar ser las gser gyi ral gri 'od 'bar ba'i yu ba la muṃ dmar ser gyis mtshan pa de rnams bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ zla nyi dbyangs gsal phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa 'od kyi rnam par 'dres pa las skad cig gis rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur pa ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rnam par mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs mtshams sprin gsar pa'i kha dog lta bu nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer 'bar ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ ral pa spyi bor bcings shing zur phud lngas mdzes pa la rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri 'od 'bar ba dpung pa'i thad du gdengs shing g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis utpa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba rgyas pa'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ lha mi'i nor bu rin po che rin thang med pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ do shal/ ska rags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa/ 'od 'phro bas mdzes par byas pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs byas pa/ dbang po'i gzhu lta bu'i kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dar dpyangs dang ldan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis 'gying zhing bzhugs pa/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs rab tu 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i tshogs spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams= /de bzhin gshegs= */ lha yi chu ni= /de bzhin bdag gis= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar mchod/ nang mchod mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor 'bul zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ sdud mdzad rnon po rdo rje'i zhal du= gsang bdag lag na rdo rje'i zhal du= rdo rje bde byed rtsal gyi zhal du= dga' rab rdo rje/ rdo rje gzhon nu rtsal gyi zhal du= 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon shantiṃ garbaha'i zhal du= slob dpon dzñā na garbaha'i zhal du= slob dpon ā kā sha garbaha'i zhal du= rdo rje myu gu gter gyi zhal du= khrag 'thung nag po/ rdo rje rtsal rgod rtsal gyi zhal du= gtsug lag dpal dge/ rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyi zhal du= slob dpon padma/ rdo rje thog 'bebs rtsal gyi zhal du= ba su dha ra/ rdo rje yang dbang gter gyi zhal du= sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom chen po'i zhal du= rdo rje gter bzhed rtsal gyi zhal du= lha rje gnubs chung*/

mtshur ston rin chen rdo rje'i zhal du= sku zhang dpal gyi zhal du= tshul khrims rin chen gyi zhal du= byang chub mgon po'i zhal du= nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi zhal du= tshul khrims mtshan can gyi zhal du= rig 'dzin gsang ba'i zhal du= rig 'dzin gnam lcags me 'bar gyi zhal du= sngags 'chang mchog grub rgyal po'i zhal du= rje btsun maṅga'i mtshan can gyi zhal du= rtsa ba'i bla ma rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa'i zhal du oṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/ rang gis myong zhing*/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod= |stong nyid las byung= /sangs rgyas byang chub= /sangs rgyas chags pa= /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa= /sangs rgyas rol la= /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa= /sangs rgyas bzhad la= /sangs rgyas gsung nyid= /sangs rgyas thugs la= /med pa las byung= /sangs rgyas 'byung ba= /nam mkha' las byung= /ye shes las byung= |sgyu 'phrul dra ba= /sangs rgyas rol ston= /thams cad thams cad khyod la= /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ bskyed rim la ci gnas su bzhag */sngags bzla ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis dbus su muṃ dmar ser gyi mthar mdun nas g.yon skor du bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i yig 'bru so sor gdan la khab btsugs pa lta bu gsal ba/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe nyi ma dang sa bon mi 'gul bar sngags phreng g.yas skor du 'khor zhing 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad bsdus te bstim/ slar 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/

'od zer rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi skur gyur/ de rnams kyis sngags bzlas pa sogs bdag nyid ji lta bar byed pas sems can mtha' yas pa dgrol bar byas/ 'od zer gyis snod bcud kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te rang la thim par gyur pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ zhes skyon drug dang bral zhing*/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems ting nge 'dzin las ma yeng ba'i ngang nas lhag gnas byas pa'i bo dhi rtsi'i phreng ba'am ru raksha'i bgrang phreng dang bcas pas sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzla dgos te/ gsang sngags sngags lnga thams cad 'khrul 'khor rgya bsdebs pa'i rgyud las/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ thugs kar muṃ las bskyed byas nas// 'phro 'du dang bcas 'bum tsho gcig /sngon du 'gro ba'i bsnyen pa ste// zhes so// de las rtags ma byung na 'bum phrag drug bzla dgos te/ zla gsang rtsa rgyud chen mo'i le'u bcu dgu par/ ye shes sems dpa' bsgoms byas nas// wā gī shwa ri drug 'bum bzla// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bsnyen pa 'di thems nas zla gsang gzhi bsnyen la zhugs na bkra shis shing nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur gyi/ zhi bsnyen ma thems par gzhi bsnyen byas na nus mthu byung yang cung zad gegs che bar mngon pas 'di gnad zab bo// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma la bdud rtsi bran/ kā la rū pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ gtor mgron rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ mchod cing bstod/ lha rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du ro gcig par gyur par mos/

rdor thal kha phye nas/ oṃ āḥ.ārya mañdzu shrī buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ātma sā dha kā ya pa ra ma ti ni dhi siddhi pra yatstshantu hūm̐ swā hā/ gsum dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ gtor mgron rang la bstim/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ 'di ni thun rjes ma dgong thun la 'don rgyu la/ byin rlabs ni gong gi sngon 'gro phyogs skyong ltar bya/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza pañtsa ṣaṣṭi ḍā ki nī da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sbyar ba gsum dang*/ las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor// mkha' 'gro drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*// phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// nas/ kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar gyis gtor ma 'bul/ yig ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ mkha' 'gro phyogs skyong rang gnas su gshegs/ thun mthar mchod bstod bya/ yig ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung 'khor la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang gi lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i muṃ la thim| de yang zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar du bsdus nas mi dmigs par gyur par bsam pa'i ngang nas ci gnas su stong nyid bsgom/ bdag gzhan snod bcud thams cad rtag pa yod 'dzin 'gog phyir 'od gsal don dam pa stong phyogs su shes rab stong pa nyid la yang dag par 'jug cing*/ de las chos thams cad med pa chad lta 'gog pa 'od gsal de las lha sku sgyu ma lta bur ldang ba ni kun rdzob snang phyogs thabs bde ba chen po ste/ sngags bla med kyi nyams len snying po mdor dril na 'di la ma 'dus pa med pa thag chod pa yin no// de las ldang tshe yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing rgyun gyi spyod lam thams cad 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi nga rgyal las ma g.yos par bya'o// rjes su bkra shis dang bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par bya/

'di la rjes gnang logs su mi dgos dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon nyid kyis chog la/ zhi bsnyen 'di thems nas zla gsang gzhi bsnyen la 'jug /de rjes las sbyor rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa thems nges su bya ba gal che/ de dag thems nas srung zlog bsad mnan sogs las rab 'byams gang dgos kyi sgrub pa 'jug go/ /tshul 'di zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi 'gor zhi sgrub la sa bcad tsam las med pas de dag gi kha skong dang*/ rang nyid bag chags dang skal pa bzang por bgyi ba'i slad dang*/ don gnyer ba rnams la'ang phan pa'i blos/ rig sngags 'chang ba chos kyi grags pas/ me khams byi ba'i lo nag pa can gyi dmar po'i bzang po gsum pa rje btsun dam pa dharma rā dza sampanna maṅga la shrī bha dra dag pa'i zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dus khyad par can la dpal 'bri gung gi pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig padma 'od du sbyar ba'i dge ba'i mthu chen pos ma gyur nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu gzigs kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
